assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: standalone original illustration for a board-game capture guide, one complete scene.
Primary request: A human hand holds a simple smartphone directly above a paused generic board game, with the phone parallel to the board. Clearly communicate recording the game before putting it away. Show only one hand and a small part of its forearm entering from the upper edge; no person or face. The slim phone is viewed from its back with a small plain camera lens, no device screen or device UI. The playing surface remains visible around and below it.
Scene/backdrop: An extremely pale blue and ivory quiet background, a modest tabletop holding a generic rectangular folding game board with a simple square path and loose abstract spaces. Dice, cream cards, blue and coral wooden pawns, honey-colored round tokens and a few calm green components rest in a plausible paused arrangement.
Style/medium: slightly anime-inspired casual board-game illustration, stylized 2D, hand-drawn clean contours, rounded shapes, gentle cel shading, lively but restrained, collectible game-art character appeal.
Color palette and materials: Blue #3978BD and coral #E56B5D wooden pawns, honey #E3B750 markers, calm green #68A68B, cream cards #FFF7E6, soft dark-navy contours. Shallow paper texture and soft 2D shadows.
Composition/framing: Square illustration, gently tilted near-overhead view, phone parallel above the board, readable separation between hand, phone and tabletop. Spacious edges, strong clear silhouettes, restrained secondary details, objects identifiable at small scale. No app frame.
Constraints: No specific game IP: no logos, named games, branded box art, recognizable board layouts, hexagonal islands, harbors, famous card designs or city-wall patterns. No glossy 3D, realistic material rendering, purple neon, glitter, sparkle, lettering, UI controls, captions, watermarks, collage or panels. No faces, full people, big mascot faces or excessive anthropomorphism; pawns are subtly charming rounded game pieces.

Asset type: standalone original illustration for saving and reopening a board-game session, one complete scene.

Composition/framing: Square illustration, clean warm inviting diagonal view into the open box. Distinct larger cards, dice, rounded pawns and circular tokens arranged in readable groups, a few objects beside the rim suggesting pause and resume. Spacious edges, strong silhouettes and restrained detail for recognition at small scale. No app frame.
Constraints: No specific game IP: no logos, named games, branded box art, recognizable board layouts, hexagonal islands, harbors, famous card designs or city-wall patterns. No glossy 3D, realistic material rendering, purple neon, glitter, sparkle, lettering, UI controls, captions, watermarks, collage or panels.
